title: 1: Top Right
context:
The London Free Press
Western Ontario's Foremost Newspaper
118th YEAR OF PUBLICATION
LONDON, ONTARIO, TUESDAY, MARCH 29, 1966—36 PAGES
Tracked by Radar
UFOs Sighted Over Wide Section of District
UFO SIGHTED BY
LEWISTON PEOPLE
An unidentified flying object
was spotted Saturday night in
Lewiston by a family of eight
persons.
Lewiston police said [illegible]
Lashley of 15 Gary Ave., spotted
the UFO at about 8:17 p.m.
above her home.
According to police, the
Lashley woman and seven other
persons sighted the object which
was described as bright blue
and grey in color, with [illegible] shapes
at one end. The UFO hovered
for a few seconds and then
sped off at a high rate of
speed in an easterly direction.
